% Canonical authority: scientific roles, support, lifecycle and completion.
\newcommand{\SupportPage}{%
\pageunit{Supported output is not the same as measured information}{sec:support}{%
A finite output value says neither where its information came from nor where
its defining operation is valid. Preserve eight separate roles:
\begin{enumerate}[nosep]
\item \textbf{Measured-parent support}: original measured occurrences, producer availability, domain and causes.
\item \textbf{Model-definition support}: separately defined candidate, accepted and applied domains, origin and transformations.
\item \textbf{Projection/removal support}: where the projected applied model and compatible subtraction exist.
\item \textbf{Residual-processing support}: each operation's input/output support, retained membership and causes.
\item \textbf{Model-rejoin support}: where the rejoin contribution is defined, independently of removal.
\item \textbf{Final output support}: the method-defined output domain and permitted path composition.
\item \textbf{Learning influence}: transitive dependence of learned/selected state on inputs, not local membership or exposure.
\item \textbf{Response-query support}: exact family, source basis/domain, conditioning, output support and limits.
\end{enumerate}
None can be waived. Materialize them or preserve exact reconstruction with
path and operation/application identities. A common mask name is not identity.
Acceptance does not imply application on the same support. Pairwise additive
compatibility remains required in addition to support compatibility.

\subsection*{Four occurrence classes, with separate mode origin}
\texttt{residual\_and\_model\_supported} means both contributions exist and may
be combined under the exact method. \texttt{residual\_only} or
\texttt{model\_only} requires explicit method permission for that narrower
path composition; absence of the other contribution is not numerical zero.
\texttt{unavailable} retains the cause and affected domain when no permitted
composition exists. A method may prohibit any class. Merely having a model at
an unmeasured location does not permit model-only output.

Undefined unequal-support behavior makes the affected output unavailable.
There is no implicit zero fill, extrapolation, imputation, renormalization,
nearest substitution, offset/gauge alignment or completion of missing measured
support. A method must bind any mapping or restriction into a common result domain.

An upstream unavailable absolute or other additive mode remains
\texttt{model\_or\_prior\_supported} if content is rejoined there. This is a
mode-level annotation, \emph{not a fifth occurrence class}: even a
residual-and-model-supported occurrence may contain such a mode. It is not
\texttt{observationally\_measured}, \texttt{recovered\_from\_data},
\texttt{acquired\_exposure} or \texttt{unit\_response\_truth}.
A gauge creates no observation. Carry mode identity and reference/gauge
consequences into response and uncertainty.

Iteration, projection and rejoin create no acquired exposure or independent
observation. Shared parents, models, calibration, response and reference
information preserve dependence. Transitive learning influence is not exposure;
no producer exposure product or reconstruction is supplied without its authority.
\src{SUPPORT\_INFORMATION\_ORIGIN; NOTATION\_AND\_ROLE\_TAXONOMY.}
}}
\newcommand{\StatePage}{%
\pageunit{An iteration changes state under a declared method}{sec:state}{%
$S_0$ is initial seed state. The generic transition records roles, not an update law:
\[
(S_k,\yin)\longrightarrow
(m_k^{\ca},m_k^{\ac},\ma,\rho_k,z_k,S_{k+1}).
\]
A nonoccurring role has a core-permitted \texttt{not\_applicable} reason;
a missing required fact has an \texttt{unavailable} cause. These are different
from numerical zero. Bind immutable base parent, exact input, lineage, branch,
absolute zero-based iteration index, method-specific identity/generation,
parent generation, state generation and application generation.

Each method must say whether the input is the original parent, the previous
result, a reconstruction from the original parent and cumulative model, or
another exact product, including any needed domain conversion. Returning to
the base and processing the prior result are different methods even with the
same model update. The base parent remains in every lineage.

\subsection*{Rules and realized values have different identities}
Changing a parent route, grouping, coefficient-recomputation rule,
learning/model-construction rule, operator family, sign, role order, bypass
graph, support rule, recurrence, stopping rule, terminal selector or failure
behavior creates a new method identity. New coefficient values, learned states
or candidate/accepted/applied models produced under unchanged rules instead
have new state, iteration and application generations. They are not aliases.

Factor each operation and consequential state component into exactly one
category: \emph{fixed numerical operator; fixed structural state with
recomputed coefficients; externally supplied; relearned; bypassed;
not\_applicable; unavailable}. Mixed stages must be factored. Each entry binds
category, owner, parent/generation, dependencies, order, application count,
path and failure. Different conditioning scopes have separate records.
A generic fixed or bypass flag is insufficient (Appendix~\ref{app:operations}).

PTC owns its estimator and application rule. Fixed loading subspace with
recomputed coefficients, frozen numerical-component subtraction and fully
relearned PTC state are distinct procedures. Recomputed coefficients do not
turn one unchanged rule into a new method on each iteration. Neither a fixed
basis nor recomputation proves a complete linear $F_k$. The exact frozen
quotation and rank restrictions are retained in Appendix~\ref{app:ptc}.

Use grouping-neutral \texttt{application\_scope\_resolved} and separate
\texttt{learned\_candidate}, \texttt{resolved\_model\_state},
\texttt{applied\_model\_state}, \texttt{realized\_iteration\_state}.
Not every model is fitted. Requested policy, effective plan, resolved state
and realized application remain distinct. One complete method grouping binds
membership, axes, scope and shared dependence. Observation-local, coadd-level
and joint versus independent learning do not commute by implication.
\src{ITERATION\_STATE\_LIFECYCLE; FRUIT\_FEEDBACK\_METHOD\_REQUIRED\_RECORD; BOUNDARIES\_AND\_CONVENTIONS B1--B2.}
}}
\newcommand{\ContinuationPage}{%
\pageunit{Continuing, stopping and selecting are different claims}{sec:continuation}{%
After completion of the iteration with absolute zero-based index $N$,
continuation begins at absolute index $N+1$ from $S_{N+1}$. $N$ is an index,
not a count. Exact continuation requires all state capable of changing a
future required result, under the same compatible future controls and declared
numerical profile. It must yield the same scientific states and results as
uninterrupted execution. A terminal signal array alone does not meet this criterion.

The continuation record binds base parent; $S_{N+1}$; separate model identities,
states and any cumulative model; learned/operator state; supports/masks;
update, selection and convergence history; counters/resource state;
stochastic generator/key/counter state where applicable; method/parameter
versions; branch/generations; additive reference/gauge and null-space state;
and every upstream/model parent. This list does not excuse an omitted
consequential fact. Materialized, compact or lineage-reconstructible forms
must preserve exact scientific state queries and reconstruction/failure
contracts. Representation alone does not change state identity.

Restart creates a new lineage with ancestry to reused state/parents; it is
not continuation. Relearning under an unchanged rule makes a successor
state/application generation and may belong to exact continuation. A rule
change makes a new method. Seed, branch, retry, completed iteration,
selected terminal and publication retain separate identities. A retry records
attempt, state/randomness and failure accounting; it creates no observation
or implicit reset (Appendix~\ref{app:operations}).

\subsection*{A limit reached does not establish convergence}
Keep \texttt{iteration\_completed}, \texttt{resource\_limit\_reached},
\texttt{converged}, \texttt{stopped\_by\_policy}, \texttt{failed},
\texttt{selected\_terminal} and \texttt{consumer\_fit} distinct.
A convergence claim binds proposition, quantity/domain, metric/norm,
scale/denominator, tolerance, direction, persistence/consecutive rule,
missing/non-finite behavior, generation and state. No value is selected here.
Convergence establishes neither correctness, unit response, unbiasedness nor fitness.

\subsection*{Selection preserves the iteration it selects}
A terminal product is a separate immutable selection record plus an immutable
completed iteration bundle. The predeclared method-owned selection rule
includes candidate population, ties, data access and failure behavior. Looking
across iterations contributes to response and uncertainty; it cannot be
hidden by reporting only the selected array.

The record has nine required fields: selected completed-iteration identity;
complete candidate population with inclusion/exclusion states; rule/generation;
convergence/stop/resource facts; causes; selected-terminal response;
selected-terminal uncertainty; continuation/terminality state; downstream
named-use status references. Appendix~\ref{app:terminal} fixes their contents.
It never mutates, relabels or replaces the selected bundle. Missing a hard
selection dependency blocks \texttt{selected\_terminal}; no last or favorable
iteration is selected by default.
\src{ITERATION\_STATE\_LIFECYCLE; SCOPE\_BRIEF \S\S4,6.}
}}
\newcommand{\CompletionPage}{%
\pageunit{Completion is a local claim with hard dependencies}{sec:completion}{%
Every completed iteration bundle retains the universal roles: immutable base
parent and exact input; method/lineage/branch/absolute iteration identities;
target and separate candidate/accepted/applied models with spaces,
transformations and equality facts; projected removal contribution, residual,
processed residual, rejoin contribution and result; update/successor state;
path support/influence and information origin; response and uncertainty
states; validity/causes; continuation state; completion/failure state; and
provenance. Removal and rejoin each bind their full additive compatibility,
conversions, reference/gauge/null-space and mode-origin consequences.

A method may add required roles or bind optional companions needed for a named
result/use. It cannot waive the universal structure or the following dependencies:
\begin{enumerate}[nosep]
\item A numerical result needs exact input, applied operand and all required
path contributions available or exactly reconstructible on the claimed
support, with compatible removal/rejoin arithmetic. Missing contributions
are never zero, identity or successful bypass.
\item Exact continuation needs every future-consequential state and compatible
profile; a result array is insufficient.
\item Numerical response/uncertainty needs its declared premises, domains,
inputs and conditioning. An unavailable companion permits only a narrower
claim allowed by \emph{both} the core and exact method, retaining status and cause.
\item Terminal selection needs a separate immutable reference to a completed
iteration satisfying core and method requirements.
\end{enumerate}
An absent role needs core-permitted \texttt{not\_applicable} and an explicit
method-defined narrower composition. Unavailable is not absent. These generic
meanings claim no actual numerical bundle or completed iteration in this draft.

ALIGN/AST own coordinate/event meaning; RTC/CAL own conditioning/calibration;
PTC owns cleaning and coefficient families; MAP/JINC own their estimands,
normalization, grouping and numerical admission; NOI owns ensemble/uncertainty
methods. FRUIT owns internal feedback selection, update, transition,
convergence, stopping and terminal selection. Other producers retain their
exact product/transformation authority. Appendix~\ref{app:boundaries} preserves
the route-conditional quantities and producer restrictions.

Downstream owners retain Pointing, OOF, source inference, catalogue and other
named-use admission. SCI-VAL may bind and evaluate an approved named-use
policy; it does not author/execute recurrence, select models, advance iterations
or choose terminal products. A missing downstream profile does not erase an
otherwise permitted complete local bundle; completeness does not confer fitness.

Consumers receive the exact underlying MAP, JINC, FLT-FIXED, FLT-MATCHED,
detector-time or other method-defined product role plus terminal-FRUIT lineage.
FRUIT ancestry creates no fifth generic numerical parent class. Naming a role
does not admit it. Publication is separate from scientific validity or readiness.
\src{ITERATION\_STATE\_LIFECYCLE; BOUNDARIES\_AND\_CONVENTIONS B3--B5; SCOPE\_BRIEF \S\S4--5.}
}}
\newcommand{\OperationsAppendix}{%
\pageunit{Operation and lifecycle records}{app:operations}{%
\small
\begin{longtable}{>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{.28\linewidth}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{.65\linewidth}}
\toprule Operation/state category & Required content \\\midrule
Fixed numerical operator & Complete exact map and fixed state; linearity, domain and support remain separate propositions.\\
Fixed structural state with recomputed coefficients & Fixed structure, recomputation rule, dependencies and realized application state; not a frozen numerical subtraction.\\
Externally supplied & Owner, exact parent/version/generation and compatibility; external does not mean independent.\\
Relearned & Learning rule, parents/population, dependence, generation and failure; included in full-procedure claims.\\
Bypassed & Exact operation absent from model path, removal/rejoin locations and counts on both paths; residual state separately classified.\\
\texttt{not\_applicable} & Exact absent role and permitted reason; not an unknown value.\\
\texttt{unavailable} & Missing/incompatible required fact, cause, domain and blocked operation/claim.\\
\bottomrule
\end{longtable}
Factor mixed stages. Each entry has exactly one category at its exact
conditioning scope, with owner, parent/generation, inputs, order, application
count, path and failure. Record separate scopes separately.
\begin{longtable}{>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{.28\linewidth}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{.65\linewidth}}
\toprule Lifecycle identity & Required meaning \\\midrule
Seed & $S_0$, lineage, exact source/model parents and method declarations.\\
Continuation & Same lineage/branch, compatible method/profile, after index $N$ at index $N+1$ from sufficient $S_{N+1}$.\\
Restart & New lineage, explicit reused ancestry; initialization/counters follow the method.\\
Relearned successor & New learned state/application generation and dependencies under unchanged rules; simultaneous restart makes a new lineage.\\
Branch & Distinct branch with parent state and departure; no relabeling earlier iterations.\\
Retry & Distinct attempt with method-defined state/randomness/failure accounting.\\
Completed iteration & Immutable input/state, result/state, $k$ and local completion/failure facts.\\
Selected terminal & Separate immutable selector record and immutable completed bundle reference.\\
Publication & Separate publication state; no convergence, consumer-fitness or validation inference.\\
\bottomrule
\end{longtable}
\normalsize
\src{ITERATION\_STATE\_LIFECYCLE.}
}}
\newcommand{\TerminalAppendix}{%
\pageunit{The complete terminal-selection record}{app:terminal}{%
Each of these nine fields retains identity, scope, generation and cause, with
values or permitted typed unavailable statuses. Hard dependencies remain binding.
\begin{description}[style=nextline,leftmargin=0pt,labelwidth=0pt,labelsep=0pt]
\item[1. Selected completed-iteration identity] Exact immutable selected iteration and bundle reference. Missing this blocks selection.
\item[2. Complete candidate iteration population considered] Every considered iteration identity and inclusion/exclusion state under the rule, plus population identity; never just favorable members.
\item[3. Exact selection rule and generation] Predeclared method-owned rule, parameters, generation, data access and tie/failure behavior.
\item[4. Convergence, stopping and resource-limit facts] Separate realized propositions and resource accounting used by selection.
\item[5. Selection causes] Why selection or failure occurred, including unavailable facts and affected scope.
\item[6. Selected-terminal response] Exact RF-05 identity/status, any RF-07 composition reference, and additive-reference/gauge/null-space consequences.
\item[7. Selected-terminal uncertainty] Exact identity, conditioning, reference/gauge/null-space consequences, omitted sources and typed status.
\item[8. Continuation or terminality state] Exact continuation-state reference or terminality proposition/status; no inferred ability to continue from a selected array.
\item[9. Downstream named-use status references] Exact consumer-profile/status references or truthful unavailable states; no inferred consumer fitness.
\end{description}
The record never mutates, relabels or replaces the selected bundle. An unavailable
hard selection fact blocks the selected-terminal claim; response/uncertainty/use
unavailability permits only the narrower claim allowed by both core and method.
The completed iteration remains immutable even when a later selection fails.
Numerical path components may be materialized or exactly reconstructible, with
required queries and failure behavior preserved.
\src{ITERATION\_STATE\_LIFECYCLE; FRUIT\_FEEDBACK\_METHOD\_REQUIRED\_RECORD.}
}}
\newcommand{\BoundaryAppendix}{%
\pageunit{Inherited producer limits}{app:boundaries}{%
PTC retains its calibrated-input transformation, correlated-mode cleaning,
coefficient families, fitted/resolved/applied state and validity. Total removed
signal is input minus output, distinct from the fitted correlated component
alone. Its transformed output is not an independent sky estimate. Fixed-state
linear null modes, modes made invariant/unidentifiable by re-estimating centering,
and affine loss from a discarded additive reference are distinct losses.
FRUIT binds placement and application state; it does not redefine the cleaner.

Every selected parent route must supply exact quantity, unit, frame, response,
beam/template convention, calibration, support, validity, lifecycle and
provenance, with all domain conversions. No route or universal unit is selected.
\emph{If} the ordinary PTC-to-MAP route is selected, its convention remains
calibrated-$x$-derived nonpolarimetric total-intensity-equivalent,
top-of-atmosphere point-source-equivalent mJy/beam with originating fixed
nominal beam/template and spectral/calibration lineage. This conditional
example establishes neither Stokes I, true sky, a generic FRUIT target nor a
universal input unit. A STOKES label does not supply authority. A normalized
map is not automatically a deconvolved or unbiased sky model.

MAP and JINC retain estimands, normalization, grouping, coefficients,
coordinate bindings, support, validity and numerical admission. Exact PTC
output, coefficient/QC identity and compatible coordinate association are
producer/consumer facts; row/time/label coincidence is not the same processed
occurrence. A MAP-permitted coefficient family does not imply JINC permission.
JINC is a signed normalized observation-map estimator. Its base authority
does not inherit ordinary MAP coaddition or expose a base response, variance,
formal-weight, covariance, empirical-noise or significance product. FRUIT's
conditional obligations manufacture none of those products. Formal weight
is not covariance or significance. Filtered/unfiltered quantities are not
interchangeable; no inverse or provisional filter is supplied.

NOI owns the exact ensemble/uncertainty method. The admitted
SCI-NOI-ODQ-110C boundary is not a freeze of the entire NOI package or a
numerical FRUIT route. Fixed-state parity, dependent successor information and
per-realization relearning remain distinct as in Section~\ref{sec:uncertainty}.
Fixed-state/relearned ensemble mixing receives no authority here.

Inherited identities are SCI-PTC v0.1/r0.5, SCI-MAP v0.1/r0.7.1 and
SCI-JINC v0.1/r0.3, with only the supplied excerpts and boundaries admitted.
Their frozen descriptions do not supply absent coefficients, parameters,
support/adequacy decisions or response information. Original files were not
reopened. Any unresolved boundary conflict must identify its exact claim and
owner; it cannot be resolved by silently modifying upstream science.
\src{BOUNDARIES\_AND\_CONVENTIONS B2--B5.}
}}
